Program Applications
Applying to graduate programs at San Diego State University is a multiple step process -- including the Cal State Apply university application, submission of official transcripts and test scores, and (in most cases) a separate program application which may require a statement of purpose, letters of recommendation, and other materials.
Program-specific applications are collected by each graduate program -- not Graduate Admissions. Please review the individual academic program for specific instructions, requirements and deadlines.
Questions regarding program specific documents should be directed to the department. Contact information for each department and links to the department website can be found on the academic program page for your major.
Information about the university application (Cal State Apply), can be found on the Graduate Admissions website.
GRE/GMAT Information: Graduate Admissions Policy Changes
San Diego State University has suspended the GRE/GMAT requirement as a campus-wide application requirement for all graduate programs. However, some programs may require the exam for their supplemental application. Please visit the program's website to see if the GRE/GMAT is required.

Cal State Apply (University Application)
Questions about the Cal State Apply application? Visit Frequently Asked Questions.
Other questions about the general university application? Visit Graduate Admissions.
For questions not answered there, email [email protected], or [email protected] for international applicants.
Questions about specific program requirements or admission decisions? See the graduate program's website or email the program advisor directly.

Cal State Apply University Application Waiver
Waivers for the Cal State Apply application fee are available in a very limited number for prospective graduate students who are California residents and demonstrate high financial need. If you meet these criteria, please email SDSU Admissions <[email protected]> to request the application fee waiver appeal form.
We also encourage you to reach out to the graduate advisor (or program director) for the degree program you are applying to, in order to learn whether they have any application fee waivers. They will also be able answer questions about program-specific application requirements.
Back to Top
Official Transcripts and Test Scores
Questions about official transcripts and test scores? Visit see Step 3 and Step 4 on the Graduate Admissions Steps to Apply page.
Still have questions about transcripts or test scores? Email [email protected], or [email protected] for international applicants.
Back to Top
Program Application - Slate
If you encounter technical issues with your Slate Graduate Supplemental Application, please email [email protected]. In the body of your email, please provide your RedID number, which can be found in the email confirmation you received after submitting your Cal State Apply application.
For all other questions regarding application materials (such as letters of recommendation, transcripts, a résumé/CV, etc.), please contact your graduate program office directly.
Contact information for graduate programs can be found below:
Master's | Doctorate | Other Graduate Degree Programs | Advanced Certificate | Credentials

Program Application - Other
Other questions about application requirements or the status of your admission decision? See the graduate program's website, or email the program advisor directly.

Prospective International Students
San Diego State University accepts applications from Graduate or Post-baccalaureate applicants who hold an acceptable baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution or one approved by a Ministry of Education and who will study in the U.S. on an F-1 Visa. To learn more about the application process, please visit the International Graduate Admissions website
